## Outcome

Roadmap task ID and the concrete problem/result. Target this personal fork.

## Changes

Explain the relevant behavior and why it satisfies the task. Identify any small
upstream compatibility patch and its reason.

## Verification

Commands/check links actually run, source/data revision for parity comparisons,
native Android/ABI evidence where applicable, and material unverified behavior.
Documentation-only changes need review and whitespace/link checks, not native CI.

## Completion

- [ ] The selected task's acceptance criteria are satisfied, or remaining work is explicit.
- [ ] Roadmap task state and concise STATUS handover are current.
- [ ] No unrelated scope expansion, generated database blobs or credentials.
- [ ] CI/artifact retention follows the project's limits; no required gate was weakened.
